info.title: BookReader
info.author: DigitalVlad
info.description: Offline ebook reader for Nintendo Switch
info.details:
BookReader is an offline ebook and comic reader for Nintendo Switch homebrew.
It supports PDF, EPUB, TXT, FB2, HTML, HTM, CBZ and Markdown files.
Features include Joy-Con and touchscreen controls, portrait and landscape modes,
PDF zoom and pan, EPUB chapters, reading progress, favorites, recent books,
Light, Sepia and Dark themes, and persistent reading settings.

changelog: Version 0.2.0 adds English and Russian interfaces, portrait mode,\ntouchscreen gestures, PDF zoom and pan, EPUB navigation, reading progress,\nfavorites, recent books, themes, and improved Switch OLED support.
